verdict.rationale: A state business-registry service could plausibly publish a developer API with interactive reference docs, so the axis applies. The evidence pack shows only web-based filing, search, forms and live chat, with no API reference, OpenAPI spec, or runnable examples. The DOR probe shows only a JavaScript app shell, not an API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
